name: Piemonte at Ontario Center
demographics: Piemonte at Ontario Center serves a diverse, family-oriented demographic in the Ontario-Rancho Cucamonga area with over 2,500 existing residential units within a half-mile radius and 4,000 additional units in planning stages. The trade area attracts middle-income households drawn to the convenient freeway access via I-10 and I-15, making it a regional destination for everyday shopping needs. Primary visitors include young families and working professionals seeking value-oriented retailers like Target and DSW, with shopping patterns focused on convenience, household essentials, and pet care services.
description: Piemonte at Ontario Center is a thriving community shopping destination strategically located at the southwest corner of 4th Street and Milliken Avenue in Ontario, California. With prime anchor tenants including Target, Big Al's, PetSmart, and Designer Shoe Warehouse, the center offers a diverse mix of quality retailers serving the everyday needs of local residents and regional shoppers. The center benefits from exceptional accessibility with direct connections to both the I-10 and I-15 freeways, positioning it as a convenient stop for the growing residential community surrounding it. The area is experiencing significant growth with over 2,500 existing residential units within a half-mile radius and an impressive 4,000 additional units currently in planning and design phases, ensuring a robust and expanding customer base for years to come. Managed by IDS Real Estate, Piemonte at Ontario Center continues to offer leasing opportunities for retailers looking to establish themselves in this dynamic and rapidly developing market.
summary: Piemonte at Ontario Center is a community shopping center anchored by Target, PetSmart, Big Al's, and DSW, located at the major intersection of 4th Street and Milliken Avenue with easy freeway access. The center serves a rapidly growing residential area with over 2,500 existing units nearby and 4,000 more in development.
